title: Control Convergence Plan — phased artifacts and ownership for SAML cutover & tenant audit retention
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: define a phased milestone ledger and ownership matrix to coordinate SAML/SSO cutover, tenant-scoped audit-log retention policies, and evidence packaging for SOC2/ISO audits. This ticket captures the plan (what to deliver each sprint), explicit acceptance checks for evidence, rollback conditions, and the cross-team handoffs required to certify cutover in production. Deliverables: 1) sprint-by-sprint milestone ledger with owners and artifacts, 2) evidence checklist for SOC2/ISO for audit-log retention per tenant, 3) staging and canary cutover runbook with rollback criteria, 4) mapping of SAML assertions to RBAC entitlements and comms plan for customers, 5) migration plan for existing audit-log schema and retention enforcement with economic impact estimates.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone ledger published with named owners and dates for the next 3 cycles
E2E staged cutover runbook validated in dedicated dev and preprod (two successful dry-runs recorded)
Evidence checklist produced that meets SOC2 control CC6 and ISO audit requirements for log retention and access controls
Customer-facing migration notes and tenant opt-in/opt-out controls documented and reviewed by Legal
Automated retention enforcement enabled behind feature-flag and rollback path established
milestones: M1 (Sprint 1): Define evidence model + ownership; complete audit-log retention matrix by tenant-type
M2 (Sprint 2): Implement retention enforcement feature-flag + basic telemetry; start SAML entitlement mapping RFC
M3 (Sprint 3): Run 2 dry-runs in staging; collect evidence artifacts and iterate checklist
M4 (Sprint 4): Canary cutover on one low-risk customer cohort; monitor SLOs and telemetry for 72 hours
M5 (Sprint 5): Full rollout and SOC2 evidence handoff readiness; post-mortem and closure
